steps.title: Wash slices in PBS
steps.instruction: Wash slices on a rotator at room temperature for four washes of 5 minutes each in 1× PBS.

steps.title: Wash slices in Tween‑20/PBS
steps.instruction: Wash slices on a rotator at room temperature for five washes of 10 minutes each in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS.

steps.title: Block tissue with BSA/NGS
steps.instruction: Incubate slices in blocking solution (0.2 % BSA, 5 % normal goat serum, 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS) using 500 µL per well, rotating for 2 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with anti‑MOR primary
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL per well of primary antibody solution containing rabbit anti‑MOR (1:10 000) in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS, agitate overnight at 4 °C and keep the plate covered with foil.

steps.title: Wash slices after MOR primary
steps.instruction: Wash slices on a rotator at room temperature for five washes of 10 minutes each in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with anti‑rabbit secondary
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with 500 µL per well of secondary antibody solution (Cy5 goat anti‑rabbit 1:500 for rat tissue, catalog #111‑175‑144; FITC goat anti‑rabbit 1:500 for mouse tissue, catalog #111‑095‑003) in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS, agitating overnight at 4 °C and covering the plate with foil.

steps.title: Wash slices after rabbit secondary
steps.instruction: Wash slices on a rotator at room temperature for five washes of 10 minutes each in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS.

steps.title: Incubate with anti‑NeuN primary
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL per well of primary antibody solution containing mouse anti‑NeuN (1:1 000) in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS, rotating for 3 hours at room temperature.

steps.title: Incubate with anti‑mouse secondary
steps.instruction: Incubate slices with 500 µL per well of secondary antibody solution (Cy3 goat anti‑mouse 1:500, catalog #115‑165‑003) in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS, agitating for 1 hour at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash slices in Tween‑20/PBS (repeat)
steps.instruction: Wash slices on a rotator at room temperature for four washes of 10 minutes each in 0.3 % Tween‑20/1× PBS, then repeat the same wash sequence once more.

steps.title: Final PBS wash
steps.instruction: Wash slices on a rotator at room temperature for one wash of 10 minutes in 1× PBS.

steps.title: Mount slices with Vectashield
steps.instruction: Mount tissue onto slides using Vectashield Antifade Mounting Medium (catalog #H‑1000) and seal the coverslip with nail polish.
